geometry.note: Reactor containment building, identified in OSM by power=generator, generator:source=nuclear, generator:output:electricity=1007 MW, manufacturer:type consistent with a CPR-1000 PWR. Assignment to the Daya Bay NIM paper's reactor-core label (D1/D2/L1/L2/L3/L4, Table 2) is inferred from which self-consistent multilateration fit of the three experimental halls' surveyed AD-to-core baselines gives the smallest residual against this building's OSM position (see geometry:daya-bay-eh1-hall method and the worklog); the paper itself does not name which physical unit is D1 vs D2 (or L1 vs L2, L3 vs L4), so this specific half of the label pair is not independently sourced, only the pair (this plant's two units) is.
